title: One Run, Observed
concept: One peach dot is one inference. The film mounts a single dot on a single rule and never unmounts it. Opening: the hero claim, near-black, occluded by three drifting spheres — a claim not shouted. The terminator rotates until the eclipse tightens to a single lit disc, and that disc IS the dot; it lands ON a rule as the ruled band draws in from the left. The dot travels its line into the eval grid, becoming the 0.42 peach cell — the failing one. It steps one rule down into the SQL result row, one rule down again into the monitoring band at 72.3% pass. Each stop holds long enough to read the number. Finally the frame pulls back: traversed lines still there, dots parked on each, resolving at glyph scale — stacked rules, one dot riding one line. The mark was the path the whole time. Wordmark surfaces by luminance beside it.
productTruth: Athina scores LLM inferences: prompt/experiment grids scoring rows 0–1, SQL over datasets, production monitoring of pass rate, cost, latency. Atomic unit is one inference on one run given a score — and honest scores are mixed (0.42, 0.34, 57% coherence, 72.3% pass).
motionThesis: Motion is measurement arriving, not speed. The only sustained travel is horizontal along a rule; everything else changes by luminance in place. Judgement arrives, then the frame stops so the number can be read.
heroMotif: A single peach dot riding a single horizontal rule — born from the sphere eclipse, carried through eval cell, SQL row and monitoring band, parked at the end inside the full-scale glyph.
spatialLogic: Black frame, one lit object. Rules are the grid: 1px horizontal runs at even ~13px gaps, full bleed, knocked out where text lands and resuming as ghost columns beside it. Headline large-left at ~1/3 width, 13px grey four-line body far right, big empty middle. Product lives in an inset rounded panel, flat and square to camera, cropped only at bottom edge as if scrolled past — never bleeding left/right. Depth is z-order only: spheres pass in front of type, uncomposited. Dot's vertical position is quantised to rule indices; camera scale is the only change of scope.
transitionLogic: Brightness is the transition. Type surfaces near-black→grey; panels wash up from black; faded members raise opacity in place. The only spatial transition is the dot's horizontal travel and its discrete one-rule vertical step, which carries the eye between states. No cut breaks the rule grid: the rule the dot sits on persists across every state change and re-registers the new frame.
typographyRole: Type is a claim that does not shout. Geometric grotesque, single weight, tight two-line headlines. Hero line runs near-black on black, physically occluded by spheres, readable only at edges — never scrimmed, glowed or lifted. Body is 13px grey, four lines, right column. Emphasis is exactly one word in tan/peach per headline ('production'). Numbers are mono, already resolved, never counted up. Wordmark appears once at the end: bold ATHINA, light AI.
imageryRole: Product is evidence, shown whole and honest: true density, real labels, unflattering numbers (0.42 peach, 0.34, 57% coherence, 72.3% pass, 32,541, $64.21, 945ms). Pastel plum/mint/olive/cream surfaces are the only colour, existing only inside product panels or as the defocused rainbow wash behind glass. Spheres are matte, one light source, single terminator, unequal sizes, overlapping.

pacingArc.note: Slowest beat. Hero line near-black, three spheres drift at different rates across it. Nothing resolves yet.
Terminator rotates, spheres tighten to one lit disc. Held, then disc settles to dot scale.
Rules wipe in from left at staggered offsets, knock out for text. Dot lands ON a rule. Quiet.
Dot travels its line into eval grid; cell tint washes in behind 0.42 peach. Hard hold ~1.2s on the failing number.
Dot steps one rule down into SQL result row; 105 ms status and blue bar chart resolve. Short hold.
Step down again; monitoring panel washes up, pill row with one active member. Hold on 72.3% pass rate.
Pull back to glyph scale: traversed rules with dots parked. Wordmark surfaces. Longest stillness, film ends on it.

continuityRules: One dot instance is mounted at 'eclipse' and never unmounted; its x, its rule index and its scale animate. Same object in every later state.
The rule the dot rides is mounted at 'rules' and persists to 'glyph'. Rules may be added but none that has carried the dot is removed.
The eval grid is mounted once at 'score'; cells change state via tint washing in behind already-present numbers. Rows are never re-created.
The pill row appears at 'observe' and stays static; only the active stroke slides between adjacent pills on a shared border.
World scale is continuous: 'glyph' is the same rule stack from 'rules' seen from further out, not a new drawing.
Sphere set from 'claim' persists through 'eclipse'; spheres do not unmount, they fall to black by luminance.
forbiddenBehaviours: No AI-purple/blue gradient background, glowing orb or neon edge-light. Saturated colour only behind glass or inside a product chip (f1).
Never add scrim, glow or contrast lift under the hero headline to make it readable. Occlusion by spheres stays (f2, v1).
Rules must never be ambient texture: no shimmer, scanline sweep, waveform or EQ-bar animation across the rule stack (f3).
No all-green dashboard. Every numeric beat must include a failing or unimpressive value: 0.42, 0.34, 57% coherence, 72.3% (f4).
No counting up. No odometer roll on 32,541 / $64.21 / 72.3%. Numbers appear already resolved; only tint behind them changes (f5, m4).
No whip-pans, streaking light, speed lines or fast cutting. No beat shorter than the time needed to read its number (f6).
No 3D tilt, perspective float or layer explosion of any product panel. UI stays flat, square to camera, still (f7).
Glyph must never be constructed from particles, network graph or logo-build assembly. Reach it by scale and framing only (f8).
No persona carousel or sliding member list; inactive members stay in place at low opacity (f9, v8).
Spheres must not bounce, squash, spin, scale-pop, gain rim light, double highlight or satellites. Only the terminator rotates (f10, m3).
Dot must never move diagonally or sit between rules. Horizontal travel on its line plus discrete vertical steps only (m1, v2).
Two competing light sources in one frame is forbidden; one illuminated object per frame (c1).
Product panel must not bleed off left and right edges; inset panel, bottom crop only (c3).
No brand gradient on editorial surfaces, no gradient on type, never two tinted words in a headline (v4, v9).
